rv.q: Francis O’Connor’s set design, meanwhile, has the tattered, impressionistic quality of memory. The flagstones of the Mundy cottage melt into the greenery of the surrounding countryside, blurring inside and outside, while the sky is a canvas of bright blue swirls of paint.
